flagged_items.explanation: Account 8000EBD30 sent to 14 distinct receivers within 48 hours, 4.2 standard deviations above its own historical average of 2.1 receivers/week - consistent with FAN-OUT structuring.
Account 8014B2A70 made 9 transfers between 9,800 and 9,950 in 36 hours, all below the 10,000 reporting threshold - amount clustering consistent with deliberate structuring.
Payment currency (USD) differs from receiving currency (EUR) on a transfer 2.8 standard deviations above this sender's average, with no prior cross-currency history on the account.
Isolation Forest flagged this transfer as an outlier on amount alone (1.9 standard deviations). No structuring rule fired and the account has consistent prior large-transfer history - likely benign.
